page.layout: One page of text, single column, full width. Running head at top with page number 64 at top right. Below the text, a centred title block of three lines (a closing title: "ANTONINI LIBERALIS METAMORPHOSEON Finis.").

main_text.p: vulpem venatur. In fatis erat, vt neque vulpis capi, neque canem euitare insequentem quicquam posset. Cum ergo iam vulpes canisque in planicie essent Thebana, Iupiter vtrunque in lapidem mu-tauit.
main_text.head: ANTONINI LIBERALIS METAMORPHOSEON Finis.

page.notes: The line below "mu-" is badly smudged by a dark stain; only the fragment "uia" (or similar, with "tauit" partly legible) can be made out, so the word "mutauit" is uncertain and the reading above is a reconstruction; the smudged line is best regarded as [illegible, ~10 letters]. The title block lines read "ANTONINI LIBERA-", "LIS METAMOR-", "phoseon Finis." and are set in spaced capitals; the hyphens are printed. The first line of text is a running line from a previous page continuation. Heading level 1 is used for the title block.
